english.title: Make a false statement to obtain a driving licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of obtaining the grant of a licence under the Road Traffic Act 1988 to

(A)_[yourself,]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE NAME..),]_

knowingly made a false statement in that **(..SPECIFY THE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(1)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
